title: School of Cybernetics Higher Degree by Research Internship
college: ANU College of Systems and Society
summary: This course provides an opportunity for HDR students to apply and develop professional skills and attributes in an area of their choice.
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must be enrolled in a PhD or MPhil program offered by the College of Engineering, Computing and Cybernetics and meet the eligibility criteria for internship placements, which include an agreement with the host institution that has also been approved by the relevant College Authorities. You will need to seek permission prior to enrolling in this course. Please refer to the link in the "Other Information" section for details.
